notes.title: [Update v1.1] Changes/Fixes are Here! + Achievements Steam
notes.notes:
[Update v1.1] Changes/Fixes are Here! + Achievements Steam

http://store.steampowered.com/app/448790

http://otakumaker.com/images/infinity_banner_616x353.png

Changes/Fixes Game: 

- New spaceship added - XKorpion.
- New enemy added - Death Armadillo.
- Life of all spaceships increased by 100%.
- Life Box added (has 16.6% change to drop after defeating any boss).
- Time between hazards leveling up decreased by 50%.
- Some graphical improvements.
- Enemies now have less life.
- Tweaks for weapon's damage of player's spaceships.
- Steam Achievements and Stats added

Enjoy!

Please restart Steam if the update isn't downloading.
XiNFiNiTY Games & OtakuMaker.com Studio
